publicReleaseNotes: First public release of Cabin: vacation-rental operations for US hosts and property managers, run on your own computer or your own Cloudflare account. Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com calendars synced both ways by iCal, with overlapping requests declined and double bookings flagged; a direct-booking page with your own Stripe payment, signed rental agreement, Stripe Identity check, damage-deposit hold released after check-out and itemized lodging tax; turnovers created by every reservation, with cleaner email, door codes, checklists and ready photos from the cleaner's phone, late finishes labelled; readiness and maintenance tasks with photos; a guest inbox with check-in details, checkout reminders and review requests sent on time and drafted replies that wait for you; stay recovery within limits you set; payout-matched monthly owner statements emailed to owners with their own portal; books posted once to Pantry, or QuickBooks CSV and IIF exports; move-in from Guesty, Hostaway or OwnerRez; agent keys that only prepare work; and local and hosted backup and restore. Not in this release: PriceLabs or Wheelhouse pricing, live QuickBooks sync, Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com messaging or partner APIs, texts in the inbox, smart-lock push, review replies and tax filing. Back up first with rer export on your own computer or rer run backup:hosted for a hosted Cabin. The checkout pins rer 0.2.47.
agentUpdateInstructions: First release; there is no earlier release to update from. New install: npx -y @runeditrun/rer dev just-every/run-cabin (or rer setup just-every/run-cabin --owner-email OWNER, then rer dev), which installs the pinned rer 0.2.47 and applies migrations 0001 to 0021 in order. A checkout that ran main before v0.1.0: back up first (on your own computer rer dev --stop and rer export --output exports/cabin-before-0.1.0.rer; hosted, from the deploying checkout with its .rer folder and .env.cabin, rer run backup:hosted -- --env-file .env.cabin --environment NAME), then git pull and rer dev, or git pull and rer deploy --env-file .env.cabin for a hosted copy; migrations apply forward only and keep homes, stays, turnovers, statements and sign-ins. rer export saves only the local copy and refuses a hosted address; never use it for a hosted backup. Restore a .rer archive with rer import --input FILE --yes into a fresh checkout, then rer setup and rer dev; restore a hosted SQL backup into a new environment with rer deploy --environment NEW --env-file .env.cabin and rer run backup:hosted -- --restore FILE --environment NEW --env-file .env.cabin --yes, then re-enter saved Stripe and AI keys. Stripe, the Anthropic drafting key, mail, Twilio, Seam and Pantry stay off until the owner adds their own keys; Cabin on your own computer sends no email. Run rer verify before adopting.
